# MGKCodes

> Independent software studio. Builds and ships its own software products from first sketch to launch: design, engineering, release, and marketing in-house.

MGKCodes (MGKCodes Ltd) is a solo-run, product-led software studio. It is product-led and partnership-style, not a client-volume web shop.

## Products

- [frunt](https://frunthospitality.com): a preparation platform for restaurant teams. It turns a restaurant's existing documents (allergen guides, SOPs, compliance paperwork) into staff training, onboarding, and compliance, with a manager dashboard and a native staff app. Live.
- [Liftio](https://www.getliftio.com/): a native iOS app for tracking workouts and progressing training. Live on the App Store.
